props.name: labels
props.description: One name per group, in matrix order.

props.name: matrix
props.description: Square flow matrix: `matrix[i][j]` is what flows from group i to group j. Row totals set each group’s arc; the diagonal is flow a group keeps.

props.name: size
props.description: Largest rendered size in pixels. The chart shrinks with its container.

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between group arcs, in radians.

props.name: colors
props.description: One CSS colour per group. Defaults walk SERIES_COLORS.

props.name: format
props.description: Format flows in the tooltip and the hidden table.
